newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent, gas oil tumble, pressured by US gasolin.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent, gas oil tumble, pressured by US gasolin.

text.p: IPE Brent and gas oil futures nose-dived as heavy selling on the NYMEX unleaded gasoline contract pushed the whole oil complex down, dealers said.
"The gasoline market is being pushed down by locals," said one IPE floor broker.
March Brent was trading 20 cents down at $20.75 a barrel at 1607 GMT, having touched a session low of $20.70 moments earlier.
Brokers saw fairly strong support at $20.64 a barrel.
Feb gas oil was trading $3.75 a tonne lower at $186.50, the intra-day low, at 1611 GMT.
"NYMEX was sold heavily by the funds on Friday and they've come back again," a broker said.
Earlier, Brent pushed higher in a technical correction to Friday's sharp sell-off which saw the front contact slide below $21 for the first time since August.
"We saw a temporary correction but the overall trend looks down," a dealer said.
